provenance.title: ON THE p-ADIC BEILINSON CONJECTURE FOR NUMBER FIELDS
provenance.authors: AMNON BESSER, PAUL BUCKINGHAM, ROB DE JEU

disposition: proposals only — promote via document-intake Stage 4; nothing here is folio content and nothing here creates Lean

candidates.statement: [\[interpolrem\]](#interpolrem){reference-type="ref" reference="interpolrem"} suggests that the role of $\zeta_k(n)$ in a analogue of Theorem [\[boreltheorem\]](#boreltheorem){reference-type="ref" reference="boreltheorem"} should be played by $\Lp p n \omega_p^{1-n} k / \Eul_p(n,k)$ where $\z_k(s) = \prod_l \Eul_l(s,k)^{-1}$ for $\Re(s) > 1$, so we can hope that $$\Lp p n \omega_p^{1-n} k \Drtp = q_p(n,k) \, \Eul_p(n,k) R_{n,p}(k)$$ for some $q_p(n,k)$ in $\Q^*$.
[\[motiveconjecture\]](#motiveconjecture){reference-type="ref" reference="motiveconjecture"} applies to $\pi$ corresponding to $\pi_j$ ($j=3,$ 4) when $t_n=2$.
